summary: The unmodified CLI iteration count controls the timed outer loop. Each iteration calls the OpenMP static row loop across all numRows; its inner loop traverses every CSR nonzero and overwrites the complete output. Initialization and the optional reference precede timing. No repetition shortcut or data-dependent omission was identified.
